messages:
alex: Quick heads-up: Deploybot will run sequenced pins in the 02:00-04:00 UTC window. Planned order: api -> runtime -> router -> console. Versions: api@1.15.0 runtime@2.6.0 router@3.10.0 console@4.3.0. @nora can you confirm warmup and KV priming?

deploybot: Deploybot: preflight OK. Will apply pins with 6s spacing and emit events. Posting step updates here.

nora: Ack. Warmup plan: prime /ops/warmup across primary shards, then 5% canary for 8m to runtime-canary. Priming KV prefixes session/* and ctx/*. Starting warmup at 01:52.

devon: Rollback thresholds: sustained error rate >0.5% for 5m OR p99 latency >1s. Staged rollback recommended: unpin router/console first, then api/runtime. @oncall_mai has unpin perms?

oncall_mai: I have perms. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/unpin-flow. Quick commands below if needed:

```
# unpin router
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/releases/unpin" -d '{"service":"router","version":"3.10.0"}'
```

alex: I'll monitor dashboards for first 12m and update release notes with rollback steps.

deploybot: api pinned -> runtime pending -> router queued -> console queued. Event: evt_176101.

nora: Warmup OK: /ops/warmup returned 200 across 4 shards. Canary at +2m: error rate stable, p99 +10ms.

oncall_mai: If I trigger rollback I'll mute noisy alerts, open incident, run staged unpins, and post timeline here.

devon: If metrics transiently spike but recover within 3m with no user reports, prefer stabilize the canary per runbook. Immediate rollback only if thresholds crossed.

alex: Router pinned, console pending. Will post final smoke status when all pins done. :white_check_mark:
